name: Sashida Akira
source:
A lively, athletic girl with muscle for brain. Tall and slender. She is the ace of the track and field team and is popular with both boys and girls.

She is close friends with Moka, who entrusts her with presenting as the leader of the Squeeze Girls in the public eye.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.a-kaguya.com/products_cc/erom/index.html#CHARACTER]official website[/url]]
